finding: C149 calls Drenth Theorem 6 a sufficient condition; the spectral-radius product inequality used in the source does not hold for general matrices under its stated assumptions.
recommended_action: For D=0.5[[1,1],[-1,-1]] and Delta=diag(1,-1), D squared is zero (spectral radius zero) and Delta is allowed, yet I-D*Delta=0.5[[1,1],[1,1]] is singular.
